• Simply interface
• Ability to scan an amiibo or importing amiibo backup from files
• Fast import with Files App
• Import ZIP file
• NTAG215 support
• Power Tag support
• Auto detect NFC support (NTAG215 or Power Tag)
• Get amiibo identifier, collection, series and more
• Refresh the latest amiibo information
• No ads or intrusive pop-ups
• Offline support
• Full support of the iOS Dark Theme
• Customize the appearance
• Keeping and search amiibo on your library

Note: You need an iPhone 7 or newer to be able to read and write NFC tags.

You don’t have to buy any subscription in the app. The app does not have any restriction if you don’t have a subscription.
